channel.description: Latest articles from The Center For Michigan | Bridge Magazine (thecenterformichigan.net)

item.title: It’s not just Palisades: Great Lakes water fuels a regional nuclear revival
item.description: Restarting an aging reactor and building next-generation modular plants on the shores of the world’s largest freshwater system.

item.title: Opinion | Michigan can ease burden on families facing devastating medical challenges
item.description: Families like ours understand the devastating financial consequences a medical diagnosis can have. Policymakers have a chance to help, including protecting access to lifesaving prescription medicines and minimizing the impact of medical debt.

item.title: Opinion | How the Justice Department failed Flint
item.description: A federal case would have avoided procedural obstacles that undermined the state prosecutions. One conclusion is impossible to escape: the state process left meaningful criminal accountability out of reach.

item.title: Fact check: How Gretchen Whitmer delivered — and didn’t — on her promises
item.description: Michigan Gov. Gretchen Whitmer made 14 promises during her 2025 State of the State address. Here’s how she did.

item.title: After nixing castration, Iron Mountain to close deer pen. Can it save the herd?
item.description: The state has forbidden the city from moving the animals, meaning killing the caged creatures might be the city’s only option after a split vote to close the deer enclosure at a city park.

item.title: Mott College trustees postpone action on alleged ‘proselytizing’ by president
item.description: Trustees of Mott Community College in Flint held a special meeting to discuss a complaint that the college's president engaged in 'religious proselytizing.'

item.title: Jocelyn Benson wants to bring high-speed rail to Michigan. What would it take?
item.description: In her bid for governor, Democrat Jocelyn Benson says she wants to build a high-speed rail network between Michigan’s largest cities.

item.title: Matt Hall pitches $4B Michigan tax overhaul, $1B energy bill savings
item.description: Republican House Speaker Matt Hall is proposing a major tax overhaul he says should amount to a net cut for Michiganders and reduce energy bills.

item.title: ‘Green Houses,’ PACE offer Michigan seniors cozier alternative to nursing homes
item.description: Two programs are helping older Detroit area residents avoid nursing homes, improving care and potentially saving tax dollars. So why aren’t there more of them?

item.title: Two projects at U-M Sparrow to expand psychiatric health services, surgery beds
item.description: The projects, estimated to cost nearly $150 million, will include a new psychiatric hospital offering in-patient care for children and adolescents for the Lansing region and partial hospitalization programs.
